speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your newborn examination. I need to understand your baby's condition; can you tell me how old the infant is and what specific symptoms have brought you in today?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The clinical picture of a term newborn with no prenatal care and no immunization history is highly suggestive of intrauterine infection. Given the lack of specific symptoms in the initial script, I must rule out other TORCH infections and congenital anomalies. REQUEST TEST: Serology for TORCH (Rubella IgM, CMV IgM, Toxoplasmosis IgM, Syphilis RPR) and urine culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Physical exam photos focusing on cardiac auscultation, skin, and limbs for microcephaly or rash.
